free_text_notes.physician_note: 63-year-old man with type 2 diabetes, hypertension, admitted 4/15 with left MCA ischemic stroke with mild right hemiparesis. Deficits stable for 48 hours; passed bedside swallow.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Ambulated in hallway with daughter present. A routine palliative care screening question was included in the admission assessment as per standard protocol. The patient did not meet the criteria for a palliative care referral.
